question: Does the component ATtiny13V-10S have a maximum voltage of 5.5V according to its datasheet?

response.reasoning: According to the ATtiny13V-10S datasheet (http://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/doc2535.pdf), the ATtiny13V has an operating voltage range of 1.8V to 5.5V, making 5.5V the maximum voltage.
